If you have more than one outlook account, my first suggestion is this:

  1. click to 'account settings' pane
  2. highlight the name of the problem account in left side bar
  3. next, in lower right, click the 'edit outgoing server' button and verify that it is the correct email address for the account,. A common problem is when two accounts are sharing the same SMTP server. Also, check that it uses the same setings as the outlook account that works. Just my suggestions... I do not know specifics of your situation.
